basic.name: Charge
basic.description:
Charge a target and deal 160 damage in an area. 

Non-Heroes take 500% increased damage.

basic.name: Rocket Fist
basic.description:
Launch a Rocket Fist that deals 150 damage to the first Hero or Structure in its path. The fist pushes Heroes for up to 2 seconds and disables Structures for 4 seconds.

Instantly kills Minions in its path.

basic.name: Shield Emitter
basic.description: Gain 25 Armor and Shield nearby allied Heroes for 500. Lasts 3 seconds.
